data.name: San Francisco Woods + Wine Tour
data.description:
Depart from Fisherman’s Wharf and head over the Golden Gate Bridge to the Russian River region for our Woods and Wine Tour! You will first visit Korbel Winery for a full tasting of California Champagne and views of their historic landscape and buildings. You can also visit their on-site deli and pick up lunch or snacks. It is delicious and you can order ahead if you choose to! After that tasting, we will travel to Armstrong Redwoods State Natural Reserve. Here you can see the Colonel Armstrong Redwoods Tree that is over 1,000 years old! You can stay for 45 minutes to an hour and half, if you choose. If you decide to visit the shorter, we then take you to downtown Guerneville to wander among this quaint American town. This is another opportunity to grab a bite to eat as well or window shop! Lastly, we will take you to Russian River Vineyards, where you will drink overlooking the vines. Here they produce award-winning wines, but are farmers first and keep a strong connection to their products. They have a restaurant here, as well, where you can order delicious sandwiches and salads, or even small bites while you experience your tasting. After this, we take you back to San Francisco through Sebastopol, where you will see a different view of California countryside.

Additional Information
Tour departs at 8:30am from 99 Jefferson street
Guests must be 21+ to participate in Wine Tastings
Please bring government-issued Photo ID
